result.description: Fanbasis (Commas) is a creator commerce and payments platform with checkout sessions, subscriptions, invoices, products, customers, discount codes and webhooks.
result.auth_detail: Per-account API key sent in the x-api-key header. Keys carry scopes. Production and sandbox keys are separate. The 401 message also mentions a Bearer token option. The MCP server uses an OAuth login flow, but that is for MCP clients, not the REST API.
result.access_detail: Keys are created in the dashboard under Account → API Keys, with a separate sandbox dashboard at sandbox.commas.net. The docs show no plan gate, app review or sales step for API keys. I found no pricing page, so I could not confirm whether the API is restricted by plan. Rate limits vary by account and need a support request.
result.api_notes: REST under https://www.fanbasis.com/public-api/. I found about 40 paths, covering checkout-sessions (including embedded), transactions, customers (charge and payment-methods), products (create, subscriptions, transactions), subscribers, invoices (mark-paid, resend, void), discount-codes and webhook-subscriptions (with a test endpoint). Sandbox environment available.
